commits.subject: fix(streak): decision streak = real MLB streak, never the model; status fresh/lagged/stale; no staleness DD-freeze
commits.body:
Reproduces + fixes the 2026-06-17 incident (dashboard showed 10 vs real MLB 8 after a missed 6/11 entry): load_decision_streak_state no longer returns max(model, contest) nor freezes doubles on staleness. The decision streak is always the contest (real MLB) value; the model replay can never raise it. Adds status fresh/lagged/stale + _has_unconfirmed_miss to flag stale-high. Keystone regression test + rewrites the 3 tests that encoded the old freeze behavior.

commits.body:
MLB profiles settle rounds as hit/not_hit/void; RESOLVED omitted not_hit, biasing freshness against reset days. Added not_hit (kept miss for legacy/local safety).

commits.subject: fix(fetch): persist activeStreak snapshot even when source_date is None
commits.body:
Snapshot/coverage split: the predictions array lags MLB's counter, so a current activeStreak was being discarded. build_observation now writes the snapshot with source_date=null when coverage is unknown; contest_state treats null source_date as stale.

commits.subject: fix(fetch-cli): always persist a current activeStreak; staleness labeled downstream
commits.body:
Removed the source_date-None failure and the currentness gate (and the now-dead latest_resolved_pick_date import) from fetch-contest-streak. A current activeStreak is written even when the per-round predictions array lags; contest_state labels lagged/stale and the level-aware health check still alerts on gap>=2. Kept the auth/identity/shape fail-safes. Added lag + source_date=None CLI regression tests; updated the 2 integration tests that encoded the old refuse-to-write gate.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(health): align contest-state staleness to the Phase-1 coverage split
commits.body:
source_date is now derived from the per-round predictions array, which trails the live activeStreak counter by ~one round BY DESIGN -- so a source_date gap is no longer a reliable staleness signal. gap==1 (the normal coverage lag) -> INFO at any time (was a daily false WARN past noon). gap>=2 downgraded CRITICAL -> WARN: a transient ledger lag must not fire a false CRITICAL DM, and the never-entered-pick detection it approximated isn't wanted (the operator is always aware of their own entries; a genuinely broken fetch still DMs via the auth-failure path). Data corruption (no/future source_date, malformed file) stays CRITICAL. De-'frozen' all messages. Codex pre-merge reviewed.
